about.heading: About Us
body: Indonesia Tanpa Polusi (Indonesia Without Pollution) is a coalition of civil society organizations advocating for clean air and equitable energy in Indonesia. We provide evidence-based information and advocate for policies that protect public health and the environment.

We comprise three main coalitions: the Sulawesi Tanpa Polusi (Sulosi), Maluku Utara Tanpa Polusi, and Kalimantan Utara Tanpa Polusi. Each coalition oversees inter-institutional consolidation for more concrete advocacy measures.

ourStories.heading: Our Stories
ourStories.body: Behind the industrial development lies a rarely heard true story. Our Stories presents the voices of residents living alongside the Captive Coal-Fired Power Plant, from their struggles with air pollution that triggers acute respiratory infections (ARI), to the loss of livelihoods as farmers and fishermen, to the loss of land due to land grabbing. These stories serve as a reminder that every policy has a real impact on people's lives.
